oneOf.description: Observed eligible notional at the decision cut-off, in the base currency.

transaction_cost_rate.description: Frozen all-in cost per unit of traded notional, never an inferred zero.

targets.description: A failed solve has no targets, not an empty or fallback allocation.

AlphaForecastV1.description: Original forecast metadata; these identifiers alone never prove qualification.

scenario_weights.description: Native dual weights in the original return-history scenario order.

DbCounter.description: Canonical decimal string in the PostgreSQL signed bigint range; nonnegative counters or positive revisions.

DecimalValue.description: Plain decimal exactly representable by NUMERIC(38,18).

owner_epoch.description: The first dispatch owner's epoch. Takeover never rewrites this frozen spec.

parameters_artifact_id.description:
Trusted native configuration stored under an immutable Artifact identity.
It does not change frozen InputSet membership or provide arbitrary commands.

expected_returns.description: Exactly one entry per original point, including warmup and unlabelled tails.

unique_test_observations.description: Distinct asset/ordinal pairs, NOT a claim of statistical independence.

notional_value.description: Native instrument valuation of this last bar's volume at its close.

bar_types.description: Complete native BarType strings, never SQL or directory prefixes.

NativeCalendarSessionV1.description: Original UTC session boundaries, including native early closes.

NativeCalendarSessionsV1.description: Original complete session data, not QZ-generated holiday rules.

last_bar_notionals.description: None means not measured, never zero liquidity or a future capacity claim.

settlements.description: Complete original condition payouts; not inferred from a last bar or expiry.

NativeJsonOutputV1.description:
An artifact download retains the original native JSON document, not an extra
envelope. Its exact variant is bound by the immutable result manifest.

oneOf.description: Required for CVAR, absent/null for VARIANCE. Strictly between zero and one.
Required only for RISK_BUDGETING; explicit asset identity, share, sign and scale.

solver_tolerance.description: Numerical stopping tolerance, not permission to violate the mandate.

input.description: Observable original numerical inputs generated inside the fixed native job.

NativePortfolioSlippageReferenceV1.description: Original last-known native BAR and tick, used only for proportional cost planning.

oneOf.description: Actual generated points, never the schedule's provisional all-cash placeholders.

outcomes.description: The complete two-outcome condition, even when only one token is traded.

settlements.description: Complete original condition payouts; not inferred from a last bar or expiry.

canonical_result.description: Unmodified native canonical document; stored as restricted simulation evidence.

returns_kind.description: UTC daily equity changes from native snapshots, never per-position fallback.

groups.description: None means unknown classification; Some([]) is explicitly ungrouped.

instrument_definitions.description:
Original Rust InstrumentAny externally tagged Serde definitions, e.g. {"CurrencyPair":{...}}.
This document is metadata, not a second instrument or matching engine.

oneOf.description: No calibration is fitted for a model already declaring expected returns.

training_end_available_ns.description: Actual availability of the last complete training label, not event time.

oneOf.description:
Positive per-horizon variance (VARIANCE) or expected loss return (CVAR) bound.
Not volatility or annualized risk; allowance is bound * exposure_tolerance.

max_turnover_per_rebalance.description: Gross traded asset notional divided by capital; cash is not charged twice.

available_ns.description: Latest availability of all assets in each window, not just event time.

end_ns.description: Common completed return windows, in strictly increasing end-time order.

started_at.description: Null only when native execution was never started.

Revision.description: Canonical decimal string in the PostgreSQL signed bigint range; nonnegative counters or positive revisions.

RuntimeCancelV1.description:
Cancellation is durable even when the original submission has not arrived yet.
The native identity is closed; a later matching or conflicting POST cannot start it.

max_output_bytes.description: Canonical decimal string in the PostgreSQL signed bigint range; nonnegative counters or positive revisions.

availability_provenance.description: A recorded source explanation. Never inferred merely from ts_init <= cutoff.

quality.description:
Exact original quality report generated by the native source owner.
Fresh DATA_VALIDATE still reopens the registered snapshot before consumption.

image_ref.description: Native immutable OCI reference. Never a model-selected image.

registered_ref.description: Exact registry key, never a filesystem path or a URL to fetch.

byte_count.description: Canonical decimal string in the PostgreSQL signed bigint range; nonnegative counters or positive revisions.

safe_message.description: A code-derived static message, never native stderr, input text or an HTTP body.

cpu_seconds.description: Canonical decimal string in the PostgreSQL signed bigint range; nonnegative counters or positive revisions.
